goal: SOTA BPC for autoregressive char-level text generation on enwik8 (target <= 1.05 BPC) and text8 (target <= 1.05 BPC).

committed_budget.source: RE-LOCKED compute budget (2026-08-09, budget-search CORRECTION). iter-19 (v27) tried 10M/384 per the previous lock and FAILED to converge (2.2631 BPC, w7to9wg0): cutting limit_chars 30M->10M + batch 96->384 slashed optimizer steps ~12x (43.7k->3.7k), leaving the model step/data-limited. The minimal converging budget is 30M chars / bs96 / 40ep, which converges to ~1.85 BPC in ~28 min. This is a budget-search correction, NOT compute inflation (we searched for and found the minimum that converges). Steps/epoch auto-rescale to actual batch via steps_per_epoch_estimate(). Architecture hyperparams (chunk_size, d_model, chunk_dec_layers, nhead, dim_ff, quantized_dim, compressor_emb_dim, token_dec_*, dropout, lr, weight_decay, ...) are NOT locked and MAY be tuned/swept.

config_effective.acc: TPU v5e-8 (8 chips), mixed_bfloat16, vectorized sliding_window_view tf.data

current_best.time_to_convergence: ~28.3 min (1700s fit) to 1.8483 BPC @ E40 at re-locked 30M/512/40ep/bs96 budget. Beat old 1.8833 best at ~E26 (~12.4 min). Full-epoch times: ~28s/epoch (QK-norm 8L chunk dec).

sota_reference.note: SOTA targets here are ballpark recent transformer-class results; the canonical target is improving on the user's own current best BPC, then chasing published SOTA.
